title: Terra Type C
property: Terra Residences, Presint 8 Putrajaya — Type C
description: Virtual tour of a Terra Residences Type C apartment at Presint 8, Putrajaya — entrance and utility yard, dining, living and kitchen, a study area, and the master suite with bathroom.

scenes.title: Main Entrance
scenes.description: Main entrance to the unit — timber door with a digital lock and light switches beside it.

scenes.title: Yard
scenes.description: Utility yard with a stainless steel sink, built-in linen shelving and a window for ventilation and daylight.

scenes.title: Dining
scenes.description: Dining area with a glass table, chairs and pendant lighting, next to the built-in study desk.

scenes.title: Living Room
scenes.description: Living area with a curved sofa, vertical timber slat wall feature and black metal shelving.

scenes.title: Kitchen
scenes.description: Kitchen with dark timber cabinetry and a clean, minimal finish.

scenes.title: Study Area
scenes.description: Study area with a desk and office chair, open shelving and a dark counter with sink.

scenes.title: Master Bedroom Entrance
scenes.description: Walkway from the study area into the master suite, flanked by timber wardrobe and shelving.

scenes.title: Master Bedroom
scenes.description: Master bedroom with double doors, wall-mounted TV, bedside table and built-in wardrobe.

scenes.title: Master Bathroom
scenes.description: Master bathroom with patterned wall tiling and walk-in wardrobe storage.
